description: Vellum Assistant on the text-only GLM 5.2 (served by Fireworks), with the image-fallback plugin in its default caption mode: every image the agent reads is described up front by the vision profile, and the image_ask tool is available on top of that. The caption half of the caption-versus-handle-only comparison on detailed image extraction. The shipped Anthropic profile stays enabled and is what the fallback calls for vision.
setup: assistant inference providers connections create fireworks-personal --provider fireworks --auth api_key --credential credential/fireworks/api_key
